semantics.clock: Capture d at each positive edge of clk when reset is inactive; evidence: positive edge triggered D flip flop.
semantics.reset: Asynchronously clear q to 0 when ar is asserted; assume active-high ar.
semantics.priority: Asserted ar overrides d at a positive clock edge.
semantics.hold: Hold q between positive clock edges unless reset is asserted; reset deassertion alone does not capture d.
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified; no initialization added.

numeric.widths: All ports are one bit as specified.
numeric.data: q stores the sampled one-bit d without arithmetic.

verification.oracle: Directed expected values derived from positive-edge D storage and asynchronous reset.
cases: Reset deassertion holds until next positive edge
Reset asserted while clock high and low
verification.sampling: Check after 1 ns to allow nonblocking assignments to settle.
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatches and bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original text says asynchronous reset ar without explicit polarity or value.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret uncomplemented ar as active high and reset as clearing q to zero.

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original text specifies no initial value.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not add initialization or require a particular power-up value in the oracle.
